reviewer: chatgpt:Codex and Astra direct image review

findings.description: Direct inspection of V209 crouch and sit renders shows both thighs projecting in front of the overskirt. The lilac hem folds behind the knees and disappears across the lap; shorts remain visibly exposed.
V209 prone fabric still bunches beneath the hips in overlapping layers, and left/right side views retain a stepped front outline from hip to hem.
The V209 arms-up render retains a gray patch at the viewer-right inner upper arm; the current view does not distinguish exposed avatar from garment shading.

nextAction: Keep V209 rejected. Increasing authored-row displacement smoothing did not change the left-front minimum orientation-safe scale (3.8147e-6) or the 891 backtracked vertices; the moderated 0.42 trial also failed to preserve the desired coverage in direct crouch/sit renders. Stop tuning this smoothing field. Change the front-lap support/deformation basis so flexed-thigh coverage does not require a collapsing shared pattern row, preserve the continuous four-panel hem, and inspect all five views and six poses. Fit, Shape Key response, production rig/weights, Unity/VRChat behavior, package and release remain unverified.
